voice.name: sultry-narrator
voice.refText: Here it is live. The server prints its multiaddr; the client dials it directly and the echo comes back over the data channel. Every other language does the same thing, natively or through the generated sidecar transport.

youtube.title: Packed structs for gRPC, in the browser #shorts
youtube.description: Cap'n-Proto-style packed structs for gRPC over WebRTC DataChannels — now in JS, Python, Lua, PHP, Ruby and Wasm. https://github.com/browser-grpc/grpc-over-datachannels

scenes.heading: Structs in the browser
scenes.say: gRPC with packed structs, now running in the browser. Protobuf stays the default; structs are opt-in where latency matters.

scenes.heading: How
scenes.say: Generate with struct codec true, negotiate with one header, and every implementation produces identical bytes, proven by twenty-one conformance drivers.
